rationale: Focus F prioritizes a controlled, opt-in pilot of a deterministic live capability, which aligns with the observed usefulness gap of needing to validate the effectiveness of such a feature before full-scale deployment. It provides a coherent deliverable with a clear success criteria and minimal risk of overcomplicating the system.

contrary_evidence: Limited natural-language patterns may be too narrow for broader use.
selected_focus.development_objective: Enable and document a controlled, opt-in pilot of a deterministic live capability to gather feedback and validate its effectiveness.
selected_focus.expected_useful_outcome: A documented, controlled, and opt-in pilot of the deterministic live capability, with feedback and validation results.
selected_focus.failure_criteria: Negative feedback or inability to validate the deterministic live capability.
selected_focus.minimum_source_scope: Risks include limited user feedback and potential issues with the narrow scope of the pilot. The scope is limited to a controlled, opt-in pilot.
selected_focus.observed_problem_addressed: To ensure the deterministic live capability can be safely and effectively used by a select group of users before full-scale deployment, providing valuable insights and adjustments.
selected_focus.retirement_criteria: Retire if no distinct consumer or user-visible value is evidenced.
selected_focus.success_criteria: Positive feedback and validation of the deterministic live capability from the pilot users.

uncertainty: There is a risk of limited user feedback and potential issues with the narrow scope of the pilot, but these are mitigated by the controlled and opt-in nature of the pilot.
